roundTrip.documents/embeds_video.json: flutter_quill's Document._transform puts a video on a line of its own when loading: it inserts "\n" before and after the inline video. quill-qt keeps the document as it is (and inserts videos on their own line itself).
roundTrip.flutter_quill/example_default_sample.jso: flutter_quill's own sample is not stable in flutter_quill: Document._transform inserts "\n" between its two consecutive video embeds.

render.documents/unknown_attributes.json: Invalid attribute values ("header": 7) throw while rendering in flutter_quill ("Invalid level 7"); the data round-trips. quill-qt reports them as load warnings and renders the text without the format.
render.documents/embeds_custom_malformed.json: flutter_quill 11.6 throws while rendering these "custom" embeds: a value that is an object instead of a JSON string ('_Map<String, dynamic>' is not a subtype of 'String'), a string that is not JSON (FormatException in CustomBlockEmbed.fromJsonString), and inner data that is not a string (CustomBlockEmbed extends BlockEmbed, whose data is a String). quill-qt reads all three, shows a chip, keeps the value; the demo always writes string data.
